Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, Boston, MA, Plano, TX, Indianapolis, IN and Columbus, OH.

You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. We will not sponsor employment visas. Candidates who will require future sponsorship, including candidates on CPT/OPT/STEMOPT who will require future sponsorship, are not eligible to apply.

Job Introduction:

Liberty Mutual Technology's Global Digital Services organization is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead program delivery for the AI Backbone, Liberty Mutual's shared enterprise foundation for AI. This role will focus on driving alignment, execution, and adoption across a broad ecosystem of stakeholders as the organization continues to expand and mature AI capabilities across the enterprise.

About the AI Backbone:

The AI Backbone provides the shared capabilities, standards, and reusable services that enable teams across Liberty Mutual to build and deploy AI solutions consistently, securely, and efficiently. Rather than having individual teams create their own approaches to security, governance, observability, identity, and AI operations, the Backbone establishes a common foundation that accelerates delivery while reducing complexity and risk.

Supporting a broad spectrum of AI use cases, from generative AI applications to advanced agentic systems, the Backbone is designed to evolve alongside the rapidly changing AI landscape. It brings together shared technical capabilities, enterprise platforms, governance, and delivery partnerships to accelerate innovation, reduce risk, and enable AI adoption across Liberty Mutual.

The Role of this Technical Program Manager

The TPM joining this program will play a pivotal role in helping Liberty Mutual realize the full potential of AI as an enterprise capability. Working across a diverse ecosystem of technology, data, security, architecture, finance, and business stakeholders, this leader will drive alignment around shared priorities, informed decision-making, and the successful adoption of the capabilities, standards, and operating models that enable AI at scale.

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence how Liberty Mutual scales and governs AI across the enterprise. The successful candidate will bring clarity and momentum to a rapidly evolving landscape, helping leaders make informed decisions while aligning efforts across teams, platforms, and strategic initiatives.

Success in this role requires exceptional program leadership, strong executive presence, and the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with technical curiosity and is comfortable engaging leaders across engineering, security, architecture, data, and business domains to translate enterprise AI strategy into coordinated action and measurable outcomes.
About the job:
This role is responsible for coordinating the planning, governance, and execution required to advance the AI Backbone and enable consistent adoption of shared AI capabilities across Liberty Mutual. The TPM will bring together stakeholders across technology and business domains, helping leaders make informed decisions, manage dependencies, and translate strategic priorities into measurable outcomes.
- Strategic Planning and Execution: Develop and own the multi-year AI Backbone roadmap (Now / Next / Later), sequencing work across shared capabilities, contributing teams, and strategic initiatives. Define target outcomes, phase milestones, and readiness criteria while adapting plans as technologies, priorities, and enterprise needs evolve. Guide the evolution of the Backbone operating model from managed reuse toward federated adoption. Maintain an integrated program plan and delivery rhythm across workstreams, actively managing dependency health, milestone slippage, and re-sequencing as conditions change.
- Enterprise Leadership and Alignment: Lead cross-functional planning, prioritization, and decision forums spanning Global Digital Services (GDS), Global Cyber Security (GCS), Enterprise Data & Data Science (ED&DS), Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise Observability, Finance, and lighthouse delivery teams. Foster shared accountability without direct reporting authority and establish consistent planning, reporting, and governance practices across participating teams. Set the execution quality bar for program and project leads working on AI initiatives across domains, and coach them toward consistent planning, risk, and reporting practices.
- Vendor Management: Coordinate strategic technology partners including AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Datadog, and Zscaler across evaluation, commitment, and scale-out decisions. Ensure build, buy, and partner strategies align with enterprise priorities, timelines, commercial objectives, and quality expectations.
- Enterprise Adoption and Enablement: Drive adoption of shared AI capabilities, approved patterns, and production-readiness standards across teams with varying priorities, business needs, and risk profiles. Partner across the organization to promote consistent approaches to AI delivery while establishing governance mechanisms that support long-term adoption and scale.
- Risk Management: Proactively identify systemic and cross-program risks spanning identity, governance, model risk, data access, security, and cost. Partner with GCS, ED&DS, LibertyAIR, Enterprise Architecture, and other stakeholders to address risks before they become barriers to adoption or scale. Maintain an enterprise view of risk and dependency health across the AI Backbone portfolio.
- Communication: Serve as the primary author and presenter of AI Backbone updates for Tech ELT, SLT, and business leadership. Translate complex technical concepts, program progress, tradeoffs, and investment decisions into clear, decision-oriented communications and executive-level narratives, including progress-to-goal, decisions required, and risks surfaced ahead of impact.
- Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and mature the Backbone operating model, reducing manual effort associated with onboarding, readiness assessment, governance, and reporting. Capture lessons learned and emerging best practices and incorporate them into reusable patterns, standards, and operating rhythms.

Additional Responsibilities Specific to this Role
- Portfolio Governance: Design and operate the governance model for the AI Backbone, including decision frameworks, escalation paths, production-readiness criteria, ownership models, and executive scorecards. Shift governance discussions from status reporting to informed decision-making.
- Dependency and Ownership Management: Build and maintain visibility into dependencies across shared capabilities, strategic AI initiatives, and underlying enterprise platforms. Maintain an inventory of AI and agentic initiatives, track maturity and readiness, and help resolve ownership ambiguity across teams and domains.
- Financial and Investment Management: Partner with Technology & Enterprise Finance and Strategy & Transformation to support AI FinOps, investment planning, capacity management, funding requests, and value realization metrics. Provide leaders with the information needed to make informed investment decisions and prioritize resources effectively.
- Technical Judgment and Architecture Engagement: Participate in architecture and design forums to understand tradeoffs across shared capabilities and platforms, and use that understanding to inform sequencing, readiness criteria, and risk assessment.

Scope of Ownership

This position is leveled above the standard Technical Program Manager role based on enterprise scope, stakeholder altitude, and the structural nature of the decisions it drives:
- Enterprise-wide scope. This role oversees a portfolio of shared capabilities, strategic AI initiatives, and the operating model that connects them, spanning multiple technology and business domains.
- Strategic decisions, not execution-level tradeoffs. In partnership with leadership and product teams, this TPM influences priorities, sequencing, investment direction, escalation decisions, and enterprise readiness standards that shape how AI capabilities are delivered and adopted.
- Complex problems with evolving solutions. AI technologies, operating models, and ownership boundaries continue to evolve. The role must bring structure to ambiguity, frame complex cross-organizational challenges, and guide stakeholders toward aligned decisions.
- Manages by exception. Intervenes based on program-level impact rather than task-level detail, letting capability and lighthouse teams own their execution while maintaining visibility into decisions, dependencies, and risks.
- Executive engagement. The role regularly advises and is accountable to Liberty Mutual's senior technology leaders and is responsible for providing clear, actionable insights that inform strategy, prioritization, and investment decisions.
- Impact through influence. Success is measured by alignment across stakeholders, consistency of execution, and the overall health and adoption of the AI Backbone, measured through adoption, readiness, and stakeholder confidence metrics rather than the delivery of any single workstream.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent experience.
- Minimum 12+ years of technical program management, enterprise transformation, or implementation consulting experience, including 5+ years leading multi-organization, multi-year technology programs in an agile environment.
- Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise platform, shared-services, or foundational capability program (e.g., cloud platform, data platform, identity, developer enablement, or AI/ML platform) where success depended on adoption by teams outside your reporting line.
- Working technical fluency in modern AI and agentic architectures: LLM access and model gateways, agent runtimes and orchestration, memory and semantic layers, evaluation and observability, and identity and governance controls. Familiarity with AWS Bedrock / AgentCore, Databricks / MLflow, Snowflake, Azure Entra ID, Datadog, and MCP / A2A interoperability standards is strongly preferred.
- Proven experience establishing portfolio governance – decision forums, readiness criteria, RACI, escalation frameworks and executive scorecards – across organizations that do not report to you.
- Track record of regular, high-quality communication with C-level and ELT-level technology leadership, including structuring options and investment asks and driving decisions in contentious settings.
- Experience with technology financial management: FinOps, rent / buy / build economics, business cases, capacity planning and value realization tracking.
- Demonstrated leadership of organizational change in large technology organizations, moving teams from local autonomy toward shared standards while preserving delivery velocity.
- Exceptional ability to drive and achieve major transformational outcomes through influence, without direct reporting authority, across engineering, architecture, security, data, finance and business-unit leaders.
- Strong analytical skills and comfort creating and leveraging data (readiness metrics, adoption metrics, dependency and risk density) to drive decision-making.
- Experience coaching or setting standards for other program managers or TPMs; ability to raise the execution bar across a practice.
- Proficiency in developing structured, impactful executive presentations and written narratives.
- Continual knowledge of the evolving AI and technology landscape, internal and external, to shape solutions with technical longevity.
- Bachelor's or master's degree in a technical or business discipline, or equivalent experience.
- In-depth knowledge of IT concepts, strategies and methodologies and their application to business opportunities; in-depth knowledge of agile methodology and the ability to mobilize multiple delivery teams across multiple domains toward a single mission.
- Highly developed negotiation, facilitation and consensus-building skills demonstrated through effective interactions with cross-functional stakeholders.

Travel

Description

GRS Technology Program Management is hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead technology delivery for one or more multi-year technology programs. This is a program leadership role for the AI era: you will translate strategy into executable plans, orchestrate large cross-domain delivery, manage program governance and risk, and serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across overall program leadership, Technology, Data, shared services, and other functional groups.
The TPM role is an unbiased leader focused on the technical execution of the program. You will not simply manage the program status — you will modernize how programs are managed across technology teams, embedding AI assistants, automation, and data-driven decision-making into governance, reporting, and delivery operations. You will operate as a direct partner for business program leadership & technology leaders, influence decisions at all levels, and help institutionalize consistent, AI-enabled program delivery practices across the organization.
Hiring Manager: Limarys Wilson

Key Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Delivery Management
- Drive and monitor end-to-end program technical execution: develop and maintain multi-year, multi-domain delivery plans that sequence technical work, integrations, and program increments.
- Serve as technology program manager: provide consistent, accurate, and timely program status, decisions, and delivery logistics to stakeholders and leadership.
- Run delivery operations: coordinate cutovers, command-center execution, hypercare, and handoffs to BAU/operations.

Governance, Risk & Dependency Management
- Establish and run program governance (SteerCo, decision logs, RACI/RASCI matrices, stage gates) and ensure timely escalation and clear accountability for decisions OR support program governance and visibility in programs with an overall program leader from outside the technology organization.
- Own technology program risks: identify, quantify, and mitigate risks; maintain a RAID register; escalate proactively when delivery, timeline, or budget is threatened — before problems are realized, not after.
- Continuously map and manage dependencies across teams, domains, and portfolios; detect, communicate, and drive resolution of slips before they impact downstream commitments.
- Apply AI-powered analytics to program data to surface leading risk indicators, predict schedule variances, and enable earlier, better-informed interventions.

AI Proficiency & Delivery Modernization
- Champion AI-enabled delivery: design, deploy, and continuously improve AI assistants and agents that automate program reporting, status synthesis, meeting summarization, RAID upkeep, and stakeholder communications.
- Demonstrate working AI fluency: understand generative AI concepts (LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, agents, Model Context Protocol) well enough to evaluate use cases, shape responsible adoption, and engage credibly with engineering teams building AI solutions.
- Guide teams through the AI-augmented SDLC: understand how AI coding assistants, spec-driven development, and automated testing change delivery cadence, estimation, quality signals, and team composition.
- Apply responsible-AI judgment: ensure AI usage within the program aligns with enterprise standards for security, data privacy, explainability, and ethics.
- Model and mentor AI adoption: share reusable AI assets (assistants, prompts, playbooks) with the TPM community and coach teams and peers on effective, safe use of AI in daily delivery work.

Financials, Metrics & Reporting
- Track program tech financials (burn vs. plan), surface corrective actions, and report forecast vs. actuals.
- Define, collect, and report program delivery KPIs (leading and lagging), Agile/DevOps maturity metrics, team health, and quality indicators — increasingly through automated, AI-assisted dashboards rather than manual compilation.
- Tie program reporting to business outcomes (reliability, customer experience, value realized), not just activity and milestones.

Stakeholder Management & Influence
- Build and maintain stakeholder management plans for technical execution; communicate trade-offs clearly; eliminate friction that impedes delivery.
- Present confidently to senior leadership, distilling complex technical and program information into clear insights that enable data-driven decisions.
- Partner closely with Overall Program Leads (OPLs), Product Management, Tech Leads, Architects, DevOps, Data, Security, Finance, and Procurement to ensure alignment and timely decisions.

Community & Continuous Improvement
- Engage with the enterprise TPM community to share best practices, contribute reusable playbooks and AI assets, and drive cross-program improvements.
- Play an active role in shaping how the delivery function evolves in the world of AI — piloting new ways of working and scaling what works.
- Operate independently: lead complex program workstreams with limited direction while escalating appropriately.

Qualifications

- 10+ years' experience delivering software solutions in an agile environment; experience leading large, complex, multi-year programs.
- Deep knowledge of Agile scaling practices and the ability to mobilize multiple agile teams across domains toward a shared mission.
- Strong technical fluency — able to engage credibly on architecture, integrations, cloud platforms, data/AI pipelines, and NFRs.
- Demonstrated AI proficiency: hands-on experience using generative AI tools (e.g., AI assistants, agents, copilots) to improve program execution, plus a working understanding of AI concepts sufficient to evaluate use cases and guide adoption.
- Experience with JIRA, Confluence, and SPM/portfolio tools; comfortable defining and enforcing tooling and automation standards.
- Demonstrated strength in governance, risk management, dependency mapping, and financial reporting (burn vs. plan).
- Data-driven decision-making: able to define metrics, interpret analytics, and use AI-generated insights while applying sound human judgment.
- Exceptional negotiation, facilitation, and consensus-building skills with cross-functional stakeholders.
- Highly developed interpersonal skills and executive presence; proven ability to influence without direct authority.
- Proven ability to operate with limited guidance and manage ambiguity in fast-evolving environments.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical or business discipline (or equivalent experience).
- This role is open to US based employees only

Preferred
- Experience in property & casualty insurance or other regulated industries, including familiarity with responsible-AI, compliance, and data-governance considerations.
- Experience delivering AI/ML or data-platform programs, or embedding AI into the SDLC (AI-assisted development, testing, or operations).
- Background in DevOps, release orchestration, or technical delivery leadership.
- Relevant certifications: PMP, SAFe POPM/SPC, or equivalent; AI credentials such as Google Generative AI Leader, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / AWS AI Practitioner, or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.

This position will provide structured support to help scale the impact of the workstreams that are executing on this strategy, as the Clear Architecture Vision progresses. Description

The Company:

Liberty Mutual Investments (LMI) is the investment firm for Liberty Mutual Group (Liberty) and is responsible for powering Liberty’s strategy amid profound change in global capital markets. With deep expertise in fixed income, equity, and alternative strategies, LMI invests $120+ billion ( as of 12/31/2025 ) of capital globally, taking a long-term approach across its integrated platform and has a team of over 350 investment, finance, and operations professionals located in Boston, MA, and New York, NY.

LMI has a clear purpose: build enduring businesses side-by-side with our partners, drive economic growth, and generate superior risk-adjusted returns that power Liberty’s strategy and secure its promises. We offer the best of both worlds — the look and feel of a boutique investment firm with the reputation and financial strength of a global leader. As the investment firm of a mutual with long-term capital, LMI has a single client mandate. This gives us the freedom to focus on what we do best.

Our portfolio spans a broad spectrum of public and private investments, and we are committed to expanding our capabilities and our toolkit in support of our mission. We invest across diverse asset classes, financial structures, and industries, including real estate, digital infrastructure, healthcare, renewable energy, and technology—with the aim of creating value and powering innovation. We pride ourselves on our extensive network of mutually beneficial partnerships, and we use our substantial influence, capital, and energy to drive towards a better future. #LMI #LI-LMI

The Position:

Liberty Mutual Investments is seeking a  Portfolio Product Owner to own the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes of LMI's Enterprise Data Management (EDM) product. EDM masters the security, price, issuer, FX, reference, and cash-flow data that LMI's  investment, accounting, operations, risk, and regulatory processes depend on.

This is one of the portfolio product owner roles within Financial Products, part of Global Investment Solutions (GIS), and reports to the Managing Director, Head of Financial Products. The successful candidate is the single accountable owner for the EDM portfolio: its strategy, roadmap, squad delivery, and stakeholder governance — working alongside the portfolio owners for Accounting, Operations, CECL, Automation & Productivity, and Finance Transformation.

The role sits between Financial Products, Operational Strategy and Delivery (OS&D), Investment Accounting, the LMI Data Office, Technology, and platform vendors. OS&D is a primary day-to-day partner: EDM's mastering, pricing, and exception workflows are executed and consumed there, so the Product Owner is expected to work in close and continuous partnership with OS&D on operational priorities, data-quality expectations, incident response, and the reduction of manual processing. The Product Owner sets priorities in collaboration with OS&D and Technology, leads cross-functional delivery,
and is accountable for EDM providing trusted, timely, accessible data. Current roadmap themes include security master performance, derivatives, Private Credit, pricing automation, NAIC and rating data, platform upgrades, regression testing, and reduction of manual processing.

This is an AI-first role. The successful candidate uses approved generative AI as a normal part of their own work and leads its responsible adoption across EDM product management, data operations, exception handling, support, and stakeholder self-service.

Responsibilities:

Product strategy and roadmap
- Own the EDM product vision, multi-year strategy, and a transparent roadmap aligned to investment, accounting, operational, regulatory, and technology priorities.
- Prioritize using business value, risk, regulatory importance, data quality, operational impact, cost, and complexity; make trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
- Balance strategic transformation, platform modernization, regulatory commitments, production stability, technical debt, and run-the-business demand.
- Develop business cases for material EDM investments and capability changes.
- Maintain clear boundaries between EDM product ownership and the enterprise MDM mandate, and route gaps requiring broader solutions to an accountable owner.

Data domain ownership and product health
- Own business outcomes for security master, price master, securities of interest, reference, issuer, FX, and cash-flow capabilities.
- Set and monitor measurable expectations for data quality, completeness, timeliness, availability, and operational efficiency.
- Lead improvements to mastering, pricing, exception management, reconciliation, workflow, and downstream distribution, with sustained reduction in manual processing.
- Partner with data owners and stewards on critical data elements, lineage, controls, and decision rights.
- With Technology, OS&D, and vendors, maintain EDM stability, performance, and continuity; lead business prioritization during incidents and drive root causes to permanent remediation rather than repeated manual intervention.
- Maintain heightened readiness and documented coverage arrangements around month-end, quarter-end, investment-accounting close, and regulatory reporting.

Backlog and delivery
- Act as the single accountable owner for portfolio intake and prioritization, coordinating the supporting product owners, business analysts, and data stewards assigned to EDM.
- Own the prioritized product backlog; translate outcomes into epics, features, and stories with clear problem statements, scope, dependencies, controls, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
- Lead and participate actively in PI planning, sprint planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and demos; intervene early when commitments, dependencies, or capacity put outcomes at risk.
- Manage dependencies across EDM, SimCorp Dimension, Aladdin, Snowflake, WSO, investment-accounting processes, and downstream reporting and analytics.
- Validate that delivered capability solves the intended business need and achieves measurable adoption and value.

Stakeholder Leadership and governance
- Serve as the Financial Products point of accountability for EDM strategy, prioritization, and business outcomes.
- Build trusted relationships across OS&D, Investment Accounting, Public Markets, Private Assets, Finance, Risk, Compliance, the Data Office, and Technology; influence senior stakeholders without formal reporting authority.
- Lead the EDM Product Advisory Council with decision-ready agendas covering product health, roadmap progress, risks, and trade-offs, and a transparent record of decisions, owners, and due dates.
- Define escalation paths and decision rights across Financial Products, Technology, OS&D, the Data Office, and vendors; escalate material risks with context, options, and a recommendation.

AI-enabled ways of working
- Use approved generative AI daily for strategy, research, prioritization, scenario analysis, story and acceptance-criteria drafting, test scenarios, and executive materials — retaining personal accountability for the accuracy and quality of every output.
- Critically evaluate AI output and validate facts, assumptions, and calculations before use; protect confidential, holdings, and restricted data by working only in approved tools and environments.
- Own an AI enablement roadmap for EDM spanning data onboarding, mastering, data-quality monitoring, exception management, reconciliation support, natural-language data access, incident documentation, production-support query deflection, test and regression development, and downstream self-service.
- Define measurable objectives per initiative and run controlled experiments before scaling; determine what belongs in EDM, an enterprise capability, a vendor roadmap, or improved ways of working, avoiding point solutions that add fragmentation or technical debt.
- Ensure AI use meets LMI information security, privacy, legal, model risk, and Responsible AI requirements, with defined human review, monitoring, and traceability. AI recommendations must not become unreviewed production decisions.
- Build reusable prompts, skills, and knowledge assets, and help team members adopt AI in ways that improve quality rather than volume.

Vendor management and modernization
- Represent LMI's product priorities in vendor roadmap, service, architecture, and escalation discussions; hold vendors accountable for commitments, quality, transparency, and sustainable remediation.
- Evaluate vendor advisory councils, early-access programs, and development partnerships, and ensure vendor-led innovation, including AI capability, meets LMI governance and risk requirements.
- Lead product direction for EDM modernization and business-process redesign — performance, scalability, maintainability, user workflow, data model, architectural simplification, and standardized access patterns — tied to measurable business outcomes.

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Information Systems, Data Management, Computer Science, or a related field.
- 10+ years in investment management, investment operations, investment accounting, enterprise data management, or financial technology, including demonstrated product ownership of a complex platform, data product, or enterprise capability.
- Gresham Opus EDM (Markit EDM and S&P Global EDM), GoldenSource, BNY Data & Analytics (Eagle), Rimes, or a comparable enterprise data-management platform.
- Strong command of security master, price master, reference data, data quality, data lineage, exception management, and downstream data consumption.
- Track record translating complex business needs into roadmaps, requirements, and measurable outcomes, and leading cross-functional delivery across Product, Technology, OS&D or an equivalent investment-operations function, and Data.
- Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and executive presentation skills; sound decision-making and judgment in a complex, matrixed organization.
- Agile delivery, PI planning, backlog management, and cross-product dependency management.
- Hands-on use of generative AI to improve product management, analysis, or operational workflows, with the judgment to identify unsupported conclusions and factual errors in AI output and the discipline to apply human review and data protection.
- Experience managing vendors or strategic technology partners.

Preferred Qualifications
- SimCorp Dimension, Aladdin, Snowflake, WSO, eFront, or related investment platforms.
- Insurance asset management or another highly regulated financial-services environment; public and private asset classes; investment-accounting and NAIC data requirements.
- Retrieval-augmented generation, natural-language data access, prompt design, or agentic workflow concepts; experience introducing AI capability within a governed enterprise environment.

Description

We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance.

At Liberty, you'll thrive in a hybrid setting that fosters in-person collaboration, innovation and growth. This approach optimizes both remote and in-person interactions, enabling you to connect and ideate with your team and deepen valuable relationships across the company, while still enjoying the flexibility of remote work for focused tasks and projects.

This role has a hybrid work schedule (2 days onsite) and we are considering candidates based in Portsmouth, NH, Boston, MA, Plano, TX, Indianapolis, IN, Remote and Columbus, OH.

You must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. We will not sponsor employment visas. Candidates who will require future sponsorship, including candidates on CPT/OPT/STEMOPT who will require future sponsorship, are not eligible to apply.

Job Introduction:

The Enterprise Data & Data Science organization provides centralized products, platforms, and technology support for Data Science teams across Liberty Mutual. Our team focuses on enabling the development, deployment, and adoption of AI/ML solutions through shared platforms, reusable capabilities, and enterprise-scale data science practices.

We’re looking to hire a Product Owner I candidate to help shape and deliver capabilities that make it easier for Data Scientists across Liberty Mutual to build, deploy, and operate AI and machine learning solutions.

In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of product, data science, and technology , partnering closely with Data Scientists, Engineers, Architects, and other stakeholders to understand user needs, inform product strategy and priorities, and translate opportunities into platform capabilities and improvements.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving technical problems through a product lens, using data and customer insights to inform decisions, and building experience with modern data science and AI/ML technologies.

About the job:
- Represent the voice of Data Scientists and other platform users, developing a strong understanding of their workflows, needs, and pain points.
- Help shape product strategy and roadmaps by bringing together customer insights, product analytics, technology considerations, and organizational priorities.
- Develop and use product metrics and analytics to understand platform usage, adoption, customer experience, and opportunities for improvement.
- Partners with Data Scientists, Engineers, Architects, and other stakeholders to translate customer needs and product priorities into actionable capabilities and improvements.
- Gather customer feedback and use data, product metrics, and user insights to inform prioritization and product decisions.
- Support the evaluation and adoption of technologies and capabilities that improve the data science development and model lifecycle experience.
- Help identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve user experience, and increase adoption of reusable platform capabilities and best practices.
- Develop and maintain prioritized product backlogs, including clear features, user stories, and acceptance criteria, in partnership with aligned delivery teams.
- Participate in quarterly planning, demos, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies to support effective execution and delivery.
- Communicate priorities, progress, decisions, and outcomes to stakeholders across the organization.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in technical discipline or equivalent experience,
- Minimum 5+ years of Product Owner experience.
- Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and product management practices.
- Experience working with technology teams, with level determined based on relevant experience.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use data and customer insights to identify opportunities and inform decisions.
- Ability to build strong working relationships and collaborate across technical and non-technical teams.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to varied audiences.
- Curiosity and an experimental mindset, with a demonstrated willingness to learn new technologies and approaches.
- Interest in data science, machine learning, AI, data platforms, or developer/platform experiences.
- Experience working with data, analytics, data science, software engineering, or technology platforms is preferred.
- Familiarity with modern data and AI technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, or similar platforms is a plus.

AI Fluency:

Actively uses AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and scale of work; can point to concrete workflows where AI adds value; critically evaluates and validates AI-generated output; and applies AI responsibly, protecting confidential and customer data.
